prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(no tests finished yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer sign-in until after pet adoption: Move sign-in after pet selection and customization so users establish emotional attachment before being prompted for account creation. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right at the start. Moving sign-in late in the funnel builds attachment first and addresses missing pet confusion by connecting sign-in directly to saving the created pet.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Two-column interactive pet picker: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a split two-column layout with real-time interactive pet animation previews. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion, median 89s). A rich split layout makes pet choices immediate and engaging.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive tip carousel during load: Transform the waiting screen into a spotlight view with progress estimates and interactive feature tips. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s and 81.3% conversion. Providing useful tip carousels during loading keeps users engaged.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Split screen onboarding story scroll: Redesign the initial story intro screen into a split layout explaining pet capabilities before choosing a setup path. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s and drops 23.8% of users immediately. Clarifying what desktop pets do sets better expectations.)
4: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud account save reassurance badge: Add clear copy reassuring users that signing in preserves their pet settings safely in the cloud. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop display visibility troubleshooting tip: Add an explicit visibility note and notification setting on the waiting screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not appearing on desktop or app failing to display after creation.)
6: [finish, notification] Quick controls recap on home intro screen: Add a prominent key shortcut notice and interaction summary to the final home intro screen. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with high mean time (5815s) and multiple support inquiries about basic pet interactions.)
